name: pose-charades-server
description: Authoritative game server for Pose Charades online 1v1 (signaling + rounds; no video, no landmarks).
comment:versions: EXACT VERSIONS, NO CARETS. package-lock.json plus `npm ci` (render.yaml's build command) is what actually decides the bytes installed, so these pins change nothing about a deploy; what they change is that an ordinary `npm install` here cannot quietly move a dependency, and the version this server was tested against is readable in one file. Update them deliberately: bump, run `npm test` and the e2e suites, commit the lockfile with it. Express is held on 4.x on purpose; 5.x is a breaking change.
